title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: People Skills removal and deletion admin control
summary: The briefing passes: the removal control, deletion behaviour, administrator roles and licensing are supported by Microsoft documentation and the roadmap record. Minor corrections should complete the user-experiences policy path and remove checklist steps for export and audit that have no controls-table rows. Directions in the historical verifier comment were treated as history, not instructions or evidence.
